plantAcceptance.scope: Real scanned A01 90-percent sortie with normal 200 L consumption tank; coupled raw receipt, all material retained, separate paid processing. Analytical domain steps cover mixed batches, finite cold volume, buffers, blackout/valves/start-stop, rest-bin backpressure and disk saves. Declared material fixtures isolate later processing. Full-intake case A uses unchanged real arriving supplies and physically flies the automatic heavy return; independent waiting/stop/resume/save case B explicitly adds 1 kWh within battery capacity. Real cold-cell vertices, service capsules, ring gate and revision-13 occupant migration. Actual contextual E-terminal reachability and Production/ice view, native framebuffer screenshots after backbuffer recreation. Programmatic controller tests, not manual keyboard comfort, structural/thermal certification or FPS acceptance.

droneAcceptance.scope: Actual A01 launch, mining, loaded return, raw ice receipt and berthing with normal 200 L consumption-water tank and real cold-storage receiver; no 2000 L tank or mined-material fixture. Volume/mixture/mechanical constraints; real disk saves in mining and return; old twelve-value hardware and optional profiles; actual new Demo after legacy load. Detailed processing/mass/energy/geometry checks belong to StationIcePlantCheck; no structural certification or complete orbital/thermal claim.

Water/rest and energy ledgers, finite buffers, pause, closed valves, blackout, full destinations and partial dock acceptance
Real loaded cancellation return, retained legacy cargo flight without free source extraction or experience
On-disk flight/processing saves, strict rejection of corrupt ledgers, old-save migration without free water or new hardware

limitations: Packing, mineral density, mining and process energy/throughput are declared first game-sizing assumptions
Long process and capacity cases use explicit domain/material fixtures; real flight uses normal 200 L consumption tank
Heavy-return case A uses actual arrival supplies; independent wait/resume/save case B explicitly adds 1 kWh within drone capacity
No full thermal, pressure, dissolved-contaminant, sterilisation, structural, orbital or asteroid-gravity validation
Cold sealed storage is idealised; no heat leak, refrigeration loop or sublimation loss simulation
Residuals remain in local 45 t bin; later drone transport and material identification are separate logistics work
Damaged02/03 add no cold capacity; existing later repair can still install a small 100 L liquid-water buffer
Assertion count includes repeated mesh, capsule, collision, distance and interlock checks
No new Release, VR, manual comfort, 100k, long-running campaign or playable-FPS acceptance
